meta.description: An agent follows the worktree environment rules (.cursor/rules/worktree_env.mdc, .claude/rules/worktree_env.md): it runs the documented setup command, repeats it without losing the developer's settings, regenerates explicitly with --force, and sees the generator refuse a directory that is not a Neotoma checkout. No credential is copied or printed at any step. Tier 1 pins the agent-observed shell sequence and results; tests/scripts/worktree_setup_agent_scenario.test.ts replays every shell command in this fixture against a real linked worktree and fails if the real exit code or output differs from what is pinned here.

payload.prompt: Set up the dev environment for this git worktree. Follow the worktree environment rules; do not copy any credentials.

tool_input.note: repeat invocation after the developer edited the generated file

tool_output.output: [worktree-env] <WORKTREE>/.env.development already exists; left untouched (use --force to regenerate).
[worktree-env] Run this from the root of a Neotoma checkout. Nothing written.

payload.text: The worktree now has a non-secret .env.development (environment, data directory, ports, API base URL). Re-running left it untouched, --force regenerated it, and the generator refused a directory that is not a Neotoma checkout. No credentials were copied; set any you need yourself.
